title: Profile & security
tz_help: Times are shown, and your working days counted, in this timezone.
notify_corrections: Email me when someone changes my time entries
password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
password_help: Your password is stored encrypted. Nobody can read it, not even administrators. Changing it signs out all other devices and revokes your API tokens.
sessions_help: With “Keep me signed in” a device stays signed in for {days} days after its last use, and 90 days at most.
sign_out_others_help: All other browsers and devices will need to sign in again.
tokens_help: Personal access tokens for desktop apps and scripts. Each token has its own permissions and expiry; every use is counted and the first use per day and address is logged.
token_once: Copy the token now. For security reasons it will not be shown again.
login_history_help: Successful and failed sign-ins to your account. If you don't recognize an attempt, change your password.
token_password_help: Creating a token requires your password. Tokens expire automatically; create a new one when needed.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.help: A second step at sign-in: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Microsoft or Google Authenticator). Strongly recommended for administrators and team leads.
mfa.step_scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (or enter the key manually), then type the code the app shows.
mfa.code_or_recovery: Code from the app or a recovery code
mfa.codes_help: Save these recovery codes in a safe place (password manager). Each one signs you in once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They are not shown again.
mfa.disable_help: Sign-in will only require your password again.
mfa.required: Your company requires two-factor authentication for your account. Please enable it now.

time_format_help: How times are shown and entered in the app. Reports and emails always use 24-hour times.
